name: mdisbetter-mcp
description: Convert a local file to another format through mdisbetter.com: documents, images, ebooks, audio, video and more.
long_description: Lets an agent convert files through the mdisbetter.com converter. Two tools: `convert_file` takes a path and an output format, writes the converted file and returns its path; `list_conversions` returns the output formats proven for an input extension. One local file per call. An mdisbetter.com account and an API key are required, and conversions use the same credits as the website.

api_key.title: MDisBetter API key
api_key.description: Create one in your mdisbetter.com dashboard, under API keys. It starts with mdb_sk_.

tools.name: convert_file
tools.description: Convert one local file to another format and return the path of the converted file.

tools.name: list_conversions
tools.description: List the output formats available for an input extension, or every accepted input extension.
